title: Data Analyst

nodes.title: Excel Advanced Data Modeling & Pivot Tables
nodes.subtitle: XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, nested IFs, dynamic arrays, Power Query, Pivot Charts
learning_objectives: Clean and reshape messy tabular datasets using Excel Power Query
Perform dynamic lookups and build summary financial models with XLOOKUP
feynman_prompts: Why is XLOOKUP superior to legacy VLOOKUP in performance and column flexibility?
key_misconceptions: Hardcoding static calculation values into spreadsheets instead of dynamic formulas

nodes.title: SQL Querying & Basic Aggregations
nodes.subtitle: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG)
learning_objectives: Extract and filter business data from relational databases using SQL
Calculate aggregated KPIs across customer and transaction segments
feynman_prompts: Explain the fundamental difference between WHERE (row filter) and HAVING (aggregate filter).
key_misconceptions: Using WHERE to filter on aggregate functions like SUM(sales) > 1000

nodes.title: Relational Joins & Data Normalization
nodes.subtitle: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL OUTER joins, primary/foreign keys, entity relationships
learning_objectives: Join multi-table customer and order datasets without creating Cartesian duplicates
Audit data integrity and identify orphaned records using LEFT JOIN with IS NULL
feynman_prompts: How does a Cartesian product (CROSS JOIN) occur when join conditions are omitted?
key_misconceptions: Assuming a LEFT JOIN always returns the exact same row count as the left table even when right table keys are duplicated

nodes.title: Advanced SQL: Window Functions & CTEs
nodes.subtitle: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG, running totals, modular CTEs
learning_objectives: Calculate period-over-period percentage growth using LAG and LEAD functions
Segment customers into quartile revenue tiers using NTILE and window partitions
feynman_prompts: Why are Common Table Expressions (CTEs) preferred over deeply nested subqueries for readability?
key_misconceptions: Filtering window function results in the WHERE clause instead of using an outer query

nodes.title: Python Programming for Data Analytics
nodes.subtitle: Data types, lists, dictionaries, list comprehensions, writing functions, Jupyter notebooks
learning_objectives: Write clean, reusable Python scripts to automate repetitive analytical tasks
Manipulate key-value datasets and parse JSON API responses using dictionaries
feynman_prompts: How do Python dictionaries provide fast O(1) key-based lookups compared to lists?
key_misconceptions: Using nested for-loops for dataset filtering when list comprehensions are cleaner

nodes.title: Numerical Computing with NumPy
nodes.subtitle: NumPy arrays, vectorized operations, broadcasting, array slicing, mathematical operations
learning_objectives: Perform high-speed vectorized calculations across million-row numeric arrays
Leverage NumPy array broadcasting to perform arithmetic on mismatched dimensions
feynman_prompts: Why are vectorized NumPy operations 50x faster than traditional Python for-loops?
key_misconceptions: Iterating through NumPy arrays with Python loops instead of vectorized methods

nodes.title: Data Wrangling & Cleaning with Pandas
nodes.subtitle: DataFrames, Series, filtering, groupby, handling missing values (dropna, fillna), merges
learning_objectives: Clean messy real-world datasets: handle nulls, parse dates, and remove duplicates
Aggregate multi-dimensional data using groupby and agg with custom metrics
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between inplace=True and reassigning DataFrame operations?

nodes.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) Techniques
nodes.subtitle: Summary statistics, skewness, outlier detection (IQR, z-score), correlation matrices
learning_objectives: Uncover hidden trends, anomalies, and distributions across new datasets
Detect and handle data outliers using Interquartile Range (IQR) filtering
feynman_prompts: Why can extreme outliers severely distort the arithmetic mean while leaving the median unaffected?
key_misconceptions: Assuming correlation between two variables implies a direct causal relationship

nodes.title: Data Visualization: Matplotlib & Seaborn
nodes.subtitle: Scatter plots, histograms, box plots, heatmaps, aesthetic design, color theory
learning_objectives: Design intuitive, publication-quality statistical charts using Seaborn
Select appropriate visualization types for continuous vs categorical comparisons
feynman_prompts: Why is a box plot superior to a bar chart when presenting skewed distributions?
key_misconceptions: Using 3D pie charts that distort visual proportion and mislead audiences

nodes.title: Business Metrics, Unit Economics & KPI Frameworks
nodes.subtitle: CAC, LTV, Churn rate, Retention cohorts, Net Promoter Score (NPS), conversion funnels
learning_objectives: Model customer lifetime value (LTV) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) ratios
Perform cohort analysis to track retention decay across monthly user cohorts
feynman_prompts: Why is an LTV:CAC ratio below 3:1 an indicator of unsustainable marketing spend?
key_misconceptions: Confusing active monthly users with retained high-intent paying customers

nodes.title: Power BI: Data Modeling & Star Schema
nodes.subtitle: Power BI Desktop, star schema vs snowflake schema, relationships (1:*), fact vs dimension tables
learning_objectives: Architect clean Star Schema dimensional models optimized for fast DAX queries
Configure one-to-many relationships and bidirectional cross-filtering safely
feynman_prompts: Why is a Star Schema significantly faster for analytical reporting than a normalized 3NF schema?
key_misconceptions: Enabling bidirectional cross-filtering globally, creating ambiguous query paths

nodes.title: DAX Calculations & Time Intelligence in Power BI
nodes.subtitle: Calculated columns vs measures, CALCULATE(), FILTER(), ALL(), YTD, YoY growth
learning_objectives: Author dynamic DAX measures calculating Year-over-Year (YoY) revenue growth
Master context transition and modify filter contexts using CALCULATE() and ALL()
feynman_prompts: Explain the fundamental difference between a calculated column (row context) and a measure (filter context) in DAX.
key_misconceptions: Creating calculated columns for simple aggregations, bloating memory consumption

nodes.title: Tableau Visual Analytics & Interactive Dashboards
nodes.subtitle: Tableau Desktop, pills (discrete vs continuous), parameters, LOD expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE)
learning_objectives: Build interactive executive dashboards with cross-filtering actions and parameters
Solve complex multi-level aggregations using Level of Detail (LOD) expressions
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between green pills (continuous) and blue pills (discrete) in Tableau?
key_misconceptions: Overcrowding dashboards with 15 disconnected charts without a clear visual hierarchy

nodes.title: Applied Statistics & Hypothesis Testing
nodes.subtitle: Normal distribution, p-values, t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-Square, confidence intervals
learning_objectives: Determine statistical significance of observed metrics using two-sample t-tests
Interpret p-values and confidence intervals accurately to guide executive decisions
feynman_prompts: Why does a p-value < 0.05 not guarantee that a tested business intervention has practical business impact?
key_misconceptions: Accepting the null hypothesis without verifying sample size and statistical power

nodes.title: A/B Testing & Product Experimentation Analysis
nodes.subtitle: Sample size calculation, minimum detectable effect (MDE), type I/II errors, novelty effect
learning_objectives: Design scientifically sound A/B tests with appropriate sample size and duration
Detect and mitigate statistical pitfalls like the peeking problem and novelty bias
feynman_prompts: Why does checking A/B test results daily and stopping early inflate false positive rates (peeking problem)?
key_misconceptions: Declaring a test variation winning after 2 days without accounting for day-of-week seasonality

nodes.title: Data Storytelling & Executive Presentations
nodes.subtitle: Audience empathy, narrative arcs, pyramid principle, slide design, framing insights
learning_objectives: Translate complex statistical findings into actionable executive business recommendations
Structure presentations using the Pyramid Principle (recommendation first, then supporting evidence)
feynman_prompts: Why do executive decision-makers care about business impact rather than technical methodology?
key_misconceptions: Presenting 50 raw data tables to executives without a clear 'So What?' narrative

nodes.title: Automated Reporting & ETL Pipelines
nodes.subtitle: Scheduled Python scripts, email reporting, database writes, basic airflow scheduling
learning_objectives: Automate daily executive KPI reporting delivered via Slack or email using Python
Export clean aggregated data tables into analytical data warehouses on schedule
feynman_prompts: Why is automated report generation superior to manual weekly spreadsheet export routines?
key_misconceptions: Building mission-critical reports that require manual copy-pasting every Monday morning

nodes.title: Data Governance, Privacy & Ethics
nodes.subtitle: GDPR, data anonymization, PII protection, data quality frameworks, ethical AI metrics
learning_objectives: Ensure analytical datasets comply with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)
Implement data masking and anonymization techniques to safeguard customer PII
feynman_prompts: Why is anonymizing customer identifiers essential before sharing datasets across teams?
key_misconceptions: Storing unencrypted customer personal data (emails, credit cards) in ad-hoc analytical spreadsheets

description: Master Data Analyst with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
